cases.explain: «недобрый поступок» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’ ”

cases.sentence: И мы ответили: «У нас есть ___ и есть его юный сын, рожденный ему в его старости.
cases.explain: «престарелый отец» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

cases.sentence: И мы ответили: «У нас есть престарелый отец и есть его ___, рожденный ему в его старости.
cases.explain: «юный сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

cases.sentence: Но мы ответили: «Мы не можем пойти; только если ___ пойдет с нами, тогда мы пойдем.
cases.explain: «младший брат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

cases.sentence: Мы не можем и на глаза показаться тому человеку, если не будет с нами ___».
cases.explain: «младшего брата» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
